newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPCO directors advise on takeover offer.
newsitem.headline: IPCO directors advise on takeover offer.

text.p: Independent directors of IPCO International Ltd said on Monday shareholders who held a long term view on the company's prospect might want to retain all or part of their shareholdings.

The company is being taken over by Malaysia's Promet Bhd through a subsidiary Oradea Pte Ltd at an adjusted offer price of US$2.36 per share. The offer price was at US$2.40 each before deducting final dividend of US$0.04 for financial year ended June 30 1996.

The independent directors said in a circular to its shareholders that shareholders who were positive on the outlook of the infrastructure industry and management of the Promet Group, might wish to retain all or part of their shares.

They added shareholders should note IPCO's financial performance was subject to income volatility and that any fund raising exercise in the long term might require further investments by shareholders.
Shareholders with a short-term view were advised to sell their shares in the open market if they were able to obtain a price higher than the adjusted offer price.
Acceptance of the offer closes on January 2 1997.
